entities.name: Archaeological Museum of Tétouan

entities.summary: The Tetouan Archaeological Museum in Tétouan is considered one of the most prominent cultural and historical museums in Morocco, as its historical legacy extends back more than a century. It is located in the heart of the city of Tetouan in the northwest of the country.
